name: Surge AI
h1: Surge AI ARR: $1.4B With Zero VC Funding.
intro: Surge AI reached over $1 billion of revenue with roughly 110 employees and no outside capital — quietly out-earning its far better-funded rival Scale AI. Every reported revenue and funding number is collected below, each traced back to a public source.

modelTitle: How Elite Human Feedback Commands Premium Contracts.
modelParagraphs: Surge sells premium human data for frontier model training: RLHF feedback, expert evaluations and red-teaming. There is no public rate card — contracts are quoted per engagement based on task difficulty, expertise and volume. The economics rest on a deliberate choice to pay labelers above-market rates: approved 'Surgers' earn roughly $0.30-0.40 per working minute (about $18-24 per hour of active work), with some tasks paying $16-30 flat, versus cents-per-task crowdsourcing.

That premium labor pool is the moat. Surge's labelers are full-time-trained specialists — software engineers, PhDs, domain experts — which is why frontier labs pay up and why the company cleared $1B of revenue with about 110 people, an implied ~$12.7M of ARR per employee. Anthropic has publicly documented using Surge's RLHF platform, and OpenAI, Google, DeepMind and Microsoft are widely reported clients, though Surge publishes no customer list.

faqs.a: Surge AI reported $1.4 billion in annualized revenue as of August 2025, per Reuters. It generated over $1 billion of full-year 2024 revenue (Forbes reported roughly $1.2 billion), overtaking Scale AI's ~$870M.

Surge took zero venture capital from its 2020 founding through August 2025 and remained profitable. In July 2025, Reuters reported it was seeking up to $1 billion in outside capital for the first time — largely a liquidity event allowing employees and founder Edwin Chen to sell shares.

faqs.q: How Does Surge AI Compare to Scale AI?
faqs.a: In 2024, Surge out-earned Scale AI ($1B+ vs ~$870M) with roughly 110 employees against Scale's 1,000+, while remaining independent. Scale then sold a 49% stake to Meta for $14.3B in June 2025, which triggered customer defections — a headwind Surge did not face.

Anthropic has publicly documented using Surge's RLHF platform. OpenAI, Google, DeepMind and Microsoft are widely reported clients, but Surge publishes no customer list. Pricing is enterprise-quoted per engagement based on task difficulty and expertise.

faqs.q: How Many People Work at Surge AI?
faqs.a: Roughly 110 employees at $1B+ of revenue — an implied ~$12.7M of ARR per employee, among the highest ratios ever reported, a function of its premium expert-labeler model rather than mass crowdsourcing.
